**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the Role**
------------------

As part of our growing Data Science and Analytics team, you will play an instrumental role in our company’s mission of building safe and beneficial artificial intelligence by driving data-informed decision making across our organization. You bring experience from high-bar teams and are eager to help shape the norms and best practices of a growing data science team as Anthropic continues to scale. In this unique company, technology, and moment in history, your work will be critical to informing our strategy as we deploy safe, frontier AI at scale to the world.

You’ll be the senior data science leader embedded in our Growth team and a strategic thought partner to its product and marketing leads. The Growth team’s job is to keep Anthropic on the exponential by getting more people and companies using and paying for Claude. You’ll help set direction across acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization: bringing a point of view on where to invest, how to grow revenue, and how to deliver more value for our users. As a tech lead manager, you’ll also manage a small team of Product Data Scientists, setting their agenda and raising the bar for how data shapes growth decisions.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* Act as a strategic thought partner to Growth product and marketing leads, helping shape growth strategy, roadmap priorities, and the major bets the team makes

* Establish foundational data practices and shape the analytics infrastructure Growth needs to support rapid iteration and decision-making as our products grow

--------------------------

* Have extensive experience in data science, including leading analytics for a growth or product area at significant scale
* Have 5+ years managing data science teams, including setting team direction and developing senior data scientists

* Have deep expertise in experimental design, causal inference, and statistical modeling at high scale, with enough fluency in Python and SQL to stay hands-on and guide others’ technical work
* Communicate clearly in writing and in presentations, including to executive audiences
* Have a bias for action and thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where you must create clarity and drive progress
* Care about the company’s mission of building helpful, honest, and harmless AI

jobs.title: Head of Data Science, Customer Technology
jobs.description:
The Opportunity
  
  
We are hiring a Head of Data Science for Customer Technology, a large global organization responsible for Wayfair’s experience worldwide, across web and apps. This is a pivotal role, leading a large global team of 35-40 data scientists across the United States, Canada, and India. In this role, the data science agenda you and your team define will improve every step of the shopping journey, from inspiration to discovery, search, recommendations, product evaluation, and purchase. As AI is redefining what shopping means, this is a chance to shape this future, towards a more dynamic and conversational experience that provides the right information to the customer at the right moment to help them make confident decisions.
  
  
What You’ll Own
  
  
The Next Generation Shopping Journey
  
  
You will lead and evolve the data science strategy for the shopping journey from the front door through product discovery, intelligent comparison and product details, to pricing and purchase. You will shape our agentic strategy, deepening our understanding of how customers shop with agents, and innovating to anticipate and respond to changes in this consumer behavior as agentic usage grows. You will partner closely with leading AI companies to help Wayfair show up best wherever our customers are. You will advance experiences that go beyond finding the right product, to helping customers manage their homes with assembly, installation, white glove delivery, warranty and more.
  
  
Customer Inspiration & Lifecycle
  
  
In this role, you will advance what we know about customers from new experiences that help them visualize and design a space that feels like home. You will build a coherent strategy across their multimodal interactions from clicks, conversations, imagery, video, and more. You will deepen our understanding of customer intent to power personalized experiences that meet customers across their needs, preferences, and constraints.
  
  
Omni-channel
  
  
As Wayfair expands into physical retail, you will define the data science agenda to make the ecommerce and physical retail experience seamless and complimentary, by connecting what we know about customers, their propensity and intent, and behavior onsite and in the stores. This will extend beyond the products they find and how they pick them up, to how they leverage expert help, pay in the ways that are right for them, and be rewarded across their interactions.
  
  
AI-Enabled Development
  
  
You will embrace and leverage agentic development to accelerate innovation, reimagining the software development lifecycle from opportunity identification through validation and test, while meeting our standards on data quality, accuracy, and completeness. You will invest in AI to hold a high bar on rigor and quality of insights, scale self-service tools and workflows, and enable product teams to innovate for customers.
  
  
What Success Looks Like
  
  
You deliver innovations that meaningfully impact business outcomes. You make explicit choices about where the organization will-and will not-invest. You raise the bar on customer experience, the quality and pace of data science insights, self-service ability, and ROI. You build a strong leadership bench and an organization capable of meeting customer demand reliably, while modernizing our workflows, experiences, and systems.
  
  
What You’ll Bring
  
  
\*
  
  
Leadership in heading the data science function for a large, globally distributed organization responsible for customer-facing experiences and platforms.
  
\*
  
  
Deep consumer technology and sensibilities. Judgement and perspective from having built and operated consumer technology at scale.
  
\*
  
  
Technical credibility across several relevant areas, including customer behavior analytics, predictive modeling, advanced experimental design, and managing large, multi-year technology investments.
  
\*
  
  
A record of defining and executing a multi-year data science strategy across multiple business units and technical domains, with the judgement to simplify scope, sequence investments, and pivot when an approach is not producing sufficient value.
  
\*
  
  
**Strong organizational and executive leadership:** building senior talent, and connecting investments to customer and business impact.
  
  
Helpful Experience
  
  
Experience with statistical learning and analysis, predictive model building and evaluation, multi-brand or multi-region commerce, consumer shopping technology, personalization and recommendation platforms, privacy & fraud, cloud data and infrastructure, advanced experimentation methodologies.
  
  
How We Work
  
  
This role is based in Seattle, Mountain View, Toronto, or Boston. The organization and its partners are distributed across North America and India. Success requires deliberate presence with teams and leadership across locations, including periodic travel.
  
  
Why Wayfair
  
  
Home remains a complex, high-consideration category with enormous room for technology to improve how customers discover, evaluate, purchase, deliver, and install products. Wayfair operates at a scale where platform decisions have visible customer and commercial impact-and where agentic commerce is already moving from concept to live customer behavior.
  
  
This is a rare opportunity to lead the insights that power today’s shopping experience while defining how Wayfair evolves to embrace new customer behavior and new technology trends.

Aircall is a unicorn AI-powered communications platform transforming how teams win with customers.

We bring voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and 250+ integrations together on one seamless workspace—so every customer conversation drives revenue, resolves issues faster, and builds trust. Come join us!

-------------------

As our Head of Data, you will lead both our Data Science and Data Engineering teams and set the vision for how Aircall uses data and AI to grow. * Communicate insights and recommendations clearly to stakeholders at every technical level, up to the executive team, and build trust by addressing their real needs.

### **Qualifications:**

### **Required**

* 10-15 years of experience in data science and data engineering, including 5+ years in people leadership.
* Experience leading leaders (managers or senior individual contributors) and owning a team across product and GTM data science and data engineering.
* Track record of setting and executing a multi-year data strategy that earned executive support and delivered measurable business impact.
* Hands-on understanding of modern data infrastructure: pipelines, warehousing, orchestration, and cloud data platforms.
* Experience deploying ML or AI systems to production at scale.

* Working proficiency in SQL and Python.
* Ability to communicate data concepts clearly and concisely to executives and cross-functional partners.

### **Preferred**

* B.S, M.S. or PhD in Statistics, Computer Science, Math, Operations Research, Physics, Economics, or another quantitative field.
* Knowledge of NLP, LLMs, or Bayesian testing.
* Coachable, resilient, and solution-oriented, with a bias toward action and a love of a good challenge.

jobs.title: Molecular Laboratory Technician
jobs.description:
Are you looking to kick off your career in plant science and molecular biology? CSP Labs (California Seed and Plant Lab, Inc.) is seeking a curious, detail-oriented Laboratory Technician to join our team. The incumbent will be responsible for running molecular (PCR-based) assays on seed and plant material to detect plant pathogens.  
  
**Company Profile**  
  
CSP Labs is a growth-oriented, full-service plant pathology and genotyping laboratory located in Pleasant Grove, CA. We are known for our rapid, high quality seed and plant testing services, and have a global customer base. The laboratory employs over 50 people in its seed health, plant health, molecular biology, and genotyping laboratories. To learn more, visit csplabs.com, and learn more about working at CSP Labs here. We are conveniently located in the Greater Sacramento area, and are 20 minutes from Downtown Sacramento, 15 minutes from Sacramento International Airport, and 30 minutes from Davis, CA.  
  
**Responsibilities**

  

* Sample intake, scheduling, and tracking according to established priorities and workflows

* Prepare samples for nucleic acid extraction including creating extraction plate maps, dividing seeds, setting up sample tubes, grinding, adding extraction buffer, centrifuging and transferring liquid
* Perform nucleic acid extractions using automated platforms (e.g., KingFisher and/or Maxwell) and follow SOPs for DNA/RNA workflows
* Run PCR/qPCR assays: prepare PCR plate maps, prepare master mixes, set up multi-target/multi-sample PCR reactions in 96/384-well format
* Liquid handling with pipettes: single channel, multichannel, repeaters, serological, semi-automated high throughput liquid handling equipment, etc.
* Preparation of buffers and reagents
* Manage back-sample storage, ensure proper seed extract storage, and proper disposal of testing materials
* Prepare assay controls (including negative, positive, and process controls)
* Maintain kit and reagent logs, including lot number tracking and basic inventory coordination
* Maintain a clean and organized workspace
* Basic lab chores (putting supplies away, autoclave materials, taking out trash & recycling, etc.) and general lab housekeeping (washing general glassware, general cleaning etc.)
* Ensure proper documentation is kept per our SOPs including documenting and communicating test deviations or issues
* Collaborate with teammates to share spaces/equipment and meet turnaround times
* Use personal protective equipment (PPE) and follow relevant safety SOPs
* Actively participate in the lab’s quality management system (QMS)
* Help troubleshoot equipment and assay issues
* Assist with other lab tasks or processes as needed

**Requirements**

  

* Must be willing to perform repetitive tasks for extended periods of time
* Able to pipette small volumes accurately and consistently in 384-well formats
* Strong attention to detail: labeling, plate mapping, documentation, and sample integrity
* Ability to multitask and prioritize work based on deadlines/queue
* Comfortable working in and with digital systems (LIMS, Google Sheets/Excel)

The next great drugs won't be discovered. They'll be designed. But AI can't design biology it has never seen, and the data to teach it barely exists yet.

Valen Labs is building the engine that generates it. We are a biological data company. We've orchestrated novel technology and ambitious lab machinery into an autonomous biofactory that designs, builds, and characterizes molecules at a scale and speed the field has never had. Best in class machines, best in class data.

We work with frontier AI labs to train their biology models, and we build the benchmarks that measure how well AI can actually do science, from a single binding assay to running an entire lab. We're backed by top Silicon Valley investors, including funds linked with Peter Thiel, and we're based in San Francisco.

Valen's pipeline runs on cells, and cells don't wait.

**About Transcripta Bio**

At Transcripta Bio, we're redefining the possibilities of transcriptional regulation to unlock new therapeutic frontiers. Our mission is to bridge the gap between deep biology and scalable science to discover novel drug targets and accelerate their path to the clinic. Based in Palo Alto, we're a multidisciplinary team of scientists, technologists, and innovators who thrive on collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to scientific integrity.

**About the role**

As a Senior Research Associate at Transcripta Bio, you will spearhead the design, execution, and validation of the in vitro cell models critical to discovery research. You will culture and differentiate iPSC-derived and primary cells, run compound screens for our pharma and biotech partners, and generate the western blot, ELISA, and imaging data our teams use to make decisions. Your work will directly drive the development and characterization of novel drug candidates in a highly collaborative, innovation-driven environment.

**What you'll do**

* Independently design, develop, optimize, and execute in vitro cell-based assays, including complex 2D/3D culture models, to support target identification, drug screening, and mechanistic studies.
* Maintain and expand cellular models of disease, including iPSCs and their differentiation into motor neurons and astrocytes, plus primary cells such as fibroblasts and keratinocytes.
* Perform and interpret protein and cell-based assays, such as western blots, ELISA, BCA, flow cytometry, and immunocytochemistry, to characterize cellular models and validate results; quantify and analyze data in GraphPad Prism.
* Participate in all steps of high-throughput drug screening, from cell culture and ICC to library preparation, including compound dosing on automated liquid handlers (e.g., Hamilton STARlet).
* Plan and run partner screening campaigns timed to compound arrival and deadlines, coordinating plate schedules across multiple screening cycles.
* Lead design of experiments and implementation of assays to validate target potency, efficacy, and mechanism of action using molecular, cellular, and biochemical techniques.
* Troubleshoot technical hurdles such as cell health, detachment, and plate-level variability; propose solutions and implement emerging technologies to improve throughput and data quality.
* Document protocols, report findings, and maintain rigorous electronic lab notebooks (e.g., Benchling) to established quality and compliance standards.
* Draft procedures for the standardization and validation of functional assays in-house.
* Present data at team meetings, to cross-functional project groups, and to external partners; contribute to internal reports and external publications.
* Collaborate closely with Project Management and Engineering to integrate cellular models, support high-content screening, and translate findings into development pipelines.
* Mentor and support lab personnel and interns, provide cross-training as needed, and foster a team culture of transparency and open communication across departments.
* Maintain an organized, clean lab: monitor BSCs, incubators, and liquid handlers, keep routine cleaning current, and coordinate service calls and CO2 supply.
* Lead contamination response, including incubator and room decontamination, disposal decisions, and written contamination reports.
* Manage vendor relationships and ordering for cell lines, reagents, and instruments (e.g., ATCC, Revvity, LI-COR), including CDAs and imaging data storage planning.

**Qualifications**

* Degree in cell biology, molecular biology, biochemistry, or a related field (M.S. preferred), with 4–6 years of relevant experience in industry or advanced academic settings.
* Demonstrated proficiency in mammalian cell culture, including primary cells, iPSC maintenance and directed differentiation, transfection/transduction, and cell line engineering.
* Extensive hands-on experience with western blotting, ELISA, PCR/qPCR, live and fixed cell imaging, ICC/IHC, flow cytometry, and other protein detection and validation methods.
* Experience running plate-based cell assays or compound screens, ideally with automated liquid handling.
* Proficiency with data analysis tools such as GraphPad Prism and Excel, and with an electronic lab notebook (e.g., Benchling).
* Strong aseptic technique and experience with contamination prevention and routine maintenance of incubators and BSCs.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with a proven record of multitasking and thriving in a fast-moving startup.
* Ability to work independently and on cross-disciplinary teams to drive project milestones and innovation.

### **Nice to Have**

* Experience in drug target discovery or early-stage drug development.
* Experience with high-content imaging (e.g., Opera Phenix or confocal) and imaging data management.
* Experience with drug discovery programs run with external partners.
* Familiarity with tissue processing and sonication alongside cell-based work.
* Experience mentoring interns or junior staff.

### **Additional Attributes**

* Creative problem solver, comfortable adapting to shifting priorities as research focus and internal programs evolve.
* Committed to scientific rigor, excellence, and ethics in all work, in and out of the lab.

Pay Range: $110,000-$120,000 annually

**About Transcripta Bio**

At Transcripta Bio, we're redefining the possibilities of transcriptional regulation to unlock new therapeutic frontiers. Our mission is to bridge the gap between deep biology and scalable science to discover novel drug targets and accelerate their path to the clinic. Based in Palo Alto, we're a multidisciplinary team of scientists, technologists, and innovators who thrive on collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to scientific integrity.

**About the role**

As a Senior Research Associate at Transcripta Bio, you will spearhead the design, execution, and validation of the in vitro cell models critical to discovery research. You will culture and differentiate iPSC-derived and primary cells, run compound screens for our pharma and biotech partners, and generate the western blot, ELISA, and imaging data our teams use to make decisions. Your work will directly drive the development and characterization of novel drug candidates in a highly collaborative, innovation-driven environment.

**What you'll do**

* Independently design, develop, optimize, and execute in vitro cell-based assays, including complex 2D/3D culture models, to support target identification, drug screening, and mechanistic studies.
* Maintain and expand cellular models of disease, including iPSCs and their differentiation into motor neurons and astrocytes, plus primary cells such as fibroblasts and keratinocytes.
* Perform and interpret protein and cell-based assays, such as western blots, ELISA, BCA, flow cytometry, and immunocytochemistry, to characterize cellular models and validate results; quantify and analyze data in GraphPad Prism.
* Participate in all steps of high-throughput drug screening, from cell culture and ICC to library preparation, including compound dosing on automated liquid handlers (e.g., Hamilton STARlet).
* Plan and run partner screening campaigns timed to compound arrival and deadlines, coordinating plate schedules across multiple screening cycles.
* Lead design of experiments and implementation of assays to validate target potency, efficacy, and mechanism of action using molecular, cellular, and biochemical techniques.
* Troubleshoot technical hurdles such as cell health, detachment, and plate-level variability; propose solutions and implement emerging technologies to improve throughput and data quality.
* Document protocols, report findings, and maintain rigorous electronic lab notebooks (e.g., Benchling) to established quality and compliance standards.
* Draft procedures for the standardization and validation of functional assays in-house.
* Present data at team meetings, to cross-functional project groups, and to external partners; contribute to internal reports and external publications.
* Collaborate closely with Project Management and Engineering to integrate cellular models, support high-content screening, and translate findings into development pipelines.
* Mentor and support lab personnel and interns, provide cross-training as needed, and foster a team culture of transparency and open communication across departments.
* Maintain an organized, clean lab: monitor BSCs, incubators, and liquid handlers, keep routine cleaning current, and coordinate service calls and CO2 supply.
* Lead contamination response, including incubator and room decontamination, disposal decisions, and written contamination reports.
* Manage vendor relationships and ordering for cell lines, reagents, and instruments (e.g., ATCC, Revvity, LI-COR), including CDAs and imaging data storage planning.

**Qualifications**

* Degree in cell biology, molecular biology, biochemistry, or a related field (M.S. preferred), with 4–6 years of relevant experience in industry or advanced academic settings.
* Demonstrated proficiency in mammalian cell culture, including primary cells, iPSC maintenance and directed differentiation, transfection/transduction, and cell line engineering.
* Extensive hands-on experience with western blotting, ELISA, PCR/qPCR, live and fixed cell imaging, ICC/IHC, flow cytometry, and other protein detection and validation methods.
* Experience running plate-based cell assays or compound screens, ideally with automated liquid handling.
* Proficiency with data analysis tools such as GraphPad Prism and Excel, and with an electronic lab notebook (e.g., Benchling).
* Strong aseptic technique and experience with contamination prevention and routine maintenance of incubators and BSCs.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with a proven record of multitasking and thriving in a fast-moving startup.
* Ability to work independently and on cross-disciplinary teams to drive project milestones and innovation.

### **Nice to Have**

* Experience in drug target discovery or early-stage drug development.
* Experience with high-content imaging (e.g., Opera Phenix or confocal) and imaging data management.
* Experience with drug discovery programs run with external partners.
* Familiarity with tissue processing and sonication alongside cell-based work.
* Experience mentoring interns or junior staff.

### **Additional Attributes**

* Creative problem solver, comfortable adapting to shifting priorities as research focus and internal programs evolve.
* Committed to scientific rigor, excellence, and ethics in all work, in and out of the lab.
